instructions: Heat butter in a pan and add ginger-garlic paste
Add chopped onions and saute until golden
Add tomato puree and cook for 3-4 minutes
Add garam masala, turmeric, and chili powder
Add paneer cubes and cook for 2 minutes
Garnish with fenugreek leaves and serve with naan or rice
Heat oil in a large pan
Add cumin seeds and let them crackle
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chili
Add chopped onions and saute until translucent
Add turmeric, chili powder, and coriander powder
Mix well and cover, cooking on medium heat for 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender
Serve hot with roti or rice
